title: [Bug] Anthropic API Error: Cannot modify thinking blocks in assistant messages during compaction
body:
**Bug Description**
I was getting and error and /compact and /resume did not work. switching thinking off or on did not help either. /compact
  ⎿ Error: Error during compaction: Error: API Error: 400 {"type":"error","error":{"type":"invalid_request_error","message":"messages.9.content.124: `thinking` or `redacted_thinking` blocks in the latest assistant message cannot be modified. These blocks must remain as
    they were in the original response."},"request_id":"req_011CVwFnMqtLoGRR8XYubfXE"}
